title: Essential Skills for Contract Professionals
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the essential skills required to effectively manage contracts, including communication, negotiation, and conflict management. Participants will gain hands-on experience in key techniques necessary for excelling as contract managers or administrators. These include project management principles for contractor-executed projects and methods for evaluating contractor performance.
audience: This course is tailored for professionals seeking to enhance the essential skills required for successful contract management. It is designed to enable contract professionals to collaborate efficiently with contractors and optimize contract outcomes.
methodology: The course employs a combination of individual and group exercises to reinforce learning, along with case studies and participant-led presentations followed by discussions. Pre- and post-course assessments are conducted to evaluate participants’ progress.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify critical skills essential for contract professionals.
Develop project plans to manage contracts and address deviations effectively.
Assess key risks that may impact contracts and devise appropriate mitigation strategies.
Establish criteria for monitoring contractor performance and define effective Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Enhance communication skills, including written, verbal, and non-verbal methods, for contract management.
Prepare for and conduct structured negotiations related to contracts.

items.text: Understanding contract terms and scope of work
Traits of an effective contract professional
Work breakdown structure and resource estimation
Critical path analysis and milestone charts
Gantt chart development and resource allocation
Creating and maintaining a risk log
Setting and using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Active listening and effective verbal/non-verbal communication
Fundamentals of written communication and conflict management
Introduction to negotiation concepts and strategies
Establishing Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement (BATNA)
